notes.title: Maintenance Notice for September 30th
notes.notes: [p]The server will undergo maintenance from 10:00 to 12:00 on Tuesday, September 30, 2025. During the maintenance, players will not be able to log in. Please inform each other, lords.[/p][p]After the maintenance on September 30, 2025, the "Mid-Autumn Festival Event" will be launched. In this event, the following cards can be drawn from the Jingzhe card pack: Magic Xun Yu, Divine Cai Wenji, Divine Gao Shun, and Divine Huang Yueying. From the Nirvana card pack, the following powerful magic generals can be drawn: Magic Zhao Yu and Magic Xun Yu.[/p][p]The new server S425 will be open on Saturday, September 27, 2025, at 10:00 AM.[/p][p]After the maintenance on September 30, 2025, the "Celebrate Double Festivals" event will be launched. During this event, the experience gained from wild battles will be doubled.[/p][p]The details of the "Celebrate Double Festivals" event are as follows:[/p][p]Event period: 10:00 on September 30, 2025 - 23:59 on October 15, 2025.[/p][p]Event 1: Golden Egg Gift[/p][p]During the event, golden and silver eggs will appear at random times. Defeating them will yield generous rewards.[/p][p]Event 2: Lucky Wheel[/p][p]Players can claim 3 lucky wheel tickets every day during the event. They can spin the wheel to get orange general fragments or even divine general fragments. The divine general fragments available in this lucky wheel are: Divine Cheng Pu fragment, Divine Guan Suo fragment, and Divine Yuan Shao fragment.[/p][p]Event 3: New Festival Tavern Card Pack[/p][p]The powerful magic general "Magic Guan Ping" will be available in this festival tavern card pack. Divine Cheng Pu, Divine Guan Suo, and Divine Yuan Shao will also reappear in the card pack after a long time. Don't miss the chance to draw them.[/p][p]Event 4: Exchange Rewards[/p][p]During the event, each battle in the wild has a chance to drop the words: "Celebrate", "Double", "Festivals". Collecting all these words will allow players to exchange for rewards such as gold coins, famous general treasure boxes, lottery tickets, universal celebration treasure boxes, Ratearth celebration treasure boxes, magic general fragment boxes, dragon and phoenix crystal source treasure boxes, rare treasure boxes, ordinary enhancement packs, and exploration orders.[/p][p]In addition, the "Mid-Autumn Festival Event" will have limited-time exchange rewards: "Mid-Autumn Mooncakes", "Koi Lanterns", "Sure Success Pill Fragment Pack", "Magic Chaos World Treasure Box", and "Festival City Gift Pack". Besides the festival words, players also need to add "Mooncake Tickets", "Lucky Knots", or "Yi Si Gold Coins" and "Yi Si Silver Coins" to exchange for these rewards.[/p][p]"Mooncake Tickets" and "Lucky Knots" can be obtained through wild battles during the event.[/p][p]"Yi Si Gold Coins" and "Yi Si Silver Coins" can be obtained by exchanging lucky points in the lucky wheel event.[/p][p]Event 5: Recharge Rewards[/p][p]Players will receive generous rewards for reaching certain cumulative recharge amounts during the event. The main rewards are the exclusive divine general "What Dai". Players who did not draw What Dai or did not get enough What Dai fragments in previous events can obtain them through the recharge rewards.[/p][p]In addition, several Sure Success Pills have been added to the 5,000, 10,000, and 20,000 levels of the cumulative recharge event.[/p][p]The reward for the 20,000 level has been changed to "Unlimited Magic General Selection Box". After using it, players can choose one of the 36 magic generals. Don't miss this opportunity.[/p][p]Event 6: Login Rewards[/p][p]Players can claim 50 gold coins, 50 noble points, 5 invitations, 2 medium technology accelerators, 2 medium building accelerators, and 3 lottery tickets every day during the event. Additionally, players can claim 2 "Mid-Autumn Mooncakes" and 2 "Koi Lanterns" every day.[/p][p]Event 7: Double Recharge Return[/p][p]The double gold coin reward for the first purchase in the recharge interface will be reset during the event. Players who have already made the purchase can enjoy the double gold coin reward again.[/p][p]Event 8: Reset of Single Recharge Event[/p][p]The rewards for the single recharge of 4,998 during this event have been changed to "Unlimited Magic General Selection Box * 2". The event lasts for 14 days. Don't miss this chance to get the new exclusive magic general! At the same time, the rewards for the 4998 tier have been upgraded. The original "Luxury Gift Pack" has been upgraded to "Prosperity Gift Pack" (after use, you can choose one from 25 Orange Crystals, 300 Phoenix Stones, 250 Dragon Holy Stones, 250 Rainbow Stones, 200 Mystic Phoenix Stones, or 200 Seven-color Stones).[/p][p]The Wei Kingdom Divine General Box and Wu Kingdom Divine General Box have been replaced with 2 Random Divine General Boxes, and the Guaranteed Success Pill has been replaced with a Divine Pill Box (you can choose either 2 Guaranteed Success Pills or 400 Ascension Pills). A Divine Treasure Box has been added (you can choose one from 7 types of Star-gazing Stones, 8 types of Military Books, or 1 type of Mirror-breaking Stone, with a huge quantity of each).[/p][p]Event 9: The consecutive recharge event has been reset.[/p][p]Event 10: A new round of cumulative consumption event has been launched.[/p][p]Event time: 10:00 on September 30, 2025 - 23:59 on October 15, 2025. The Divine General Fragments in the rewards have been changed to Divine Xu Huang Fragments.[/p][p]Event 11: A new round of super discount event has been launched.[/p][p]The discounted items for this round are: Divine Sima Yi Fragments, 7-day Noble Activation Item, Primary City Protection Order, Skill Points, Level 6 Attack Gem, Large Stamina Potion, Advanced Recruitment Order, and Honor.[/p][p]Event 12: The Divine General Fragments in the Merit Mall, Honor Mall, and Tiger Talisman Mall have been updated.[/p][p]The Honor Mall has been updated to: Divine Lu Bu Fragments, Divine Sun Quan Fragments;[/p][p]The Merit Mall has been updated to: Divine Cao Cao Fragments, Divine Guan Yu Fragments;[/p][p]The Tiger Talisman Mall has been updated to: Divine Huang Zhong Fragments, Divine Lu Xun Fragments.[/p][p]The new version is under development and will be updated gradually. Please stay tuned.[/p]

notes.title: Maintenance Notice for September 18th
notes.notes: [p]On Monday, September 15, 2025, inactive accounts in S406-S414 will be cleared at irregular intervals, each clearance lasting 10 to 20 minutes. An inactive account is defined as one that: 1) has not occupied a land of level 10 or above; 2) has not logged in for three consecutive days; 3) has not made any recharge. An account meeting all three conditions will be considered inactive and cleared.[/p][p]On Thursday, September 18, 2025, from 10:00 to 14:00, the entire server will undergo maintenance. After the maintenance, S406-S414 will enter the third season. For detailed season-related information, please refer to the season description in the "World Situation". Lords who have participated in the last event's roulette rewards will receive them in their mailboxes at 0:00 on September 18, 2025. If you do not collect the rewards from your mailbox before the maintenance on September 18, the mailbox will be cleared during the season settlement. Please try to collect the rewards before the maintenance. The progress and recruitment times of the new season's wish card packs and nirvana card packs will be reset. Please pay attention.[/p][p]After the maintenance on September 18, 2025, the "Autumnal Equinox Festival" event will be launched. The following cards can be drawn from the tavern card packs this period: Shén Língcāo, Shén Lǐdiǎn, and Shén Huángyuèyīng. The following powerful demon generals can be drawn from the nirvana card packs: Mó Zhāngzhāo and Mó Xiàhóuyuān.[/p][p]The new server S423 will be open on Saturday, September 13, 2025, at 10:00 AM.[/p][p]After the maintenance on September 18, 2025, the "Mid-Autumn Festival" event will be launched. Defeating them will yield generous rewards.[/p][p]Event 2: Lucky Wheel[/p][p]Log in every day during the event period to receive 3 lucky wheel tickets. You can spin the wheel to get orange general fragments or even divine general fragments. The divine general fragments available for this lucky wheel are: Shén Shìdài fragments, Shén Huátuō fragments, and Shén Huánggài fragments.[/p][p]Event 3: New Festival Tavern Card Pack[/p][p]The powerful demon general "Mó Zhānghóng" will be available in this festival tavern card pack. Players who have already made the purchase can enjoy the double gold coins again.[/p][p]Activity 8: Reset of Single Recharge Event[/p][p]The reward for the 4,998 single recharge tier this period is "Magic Zhao Yun Fragment * 200". The event lasts for 14 days. Don't miss this new exclusive magic general![/p][p]At the same time, the 4,998 tier reward has been upgraded. The original "Luxury Gift Box" has been upgraded to the "Wealthy Gift Box" (after use, you can choose one of 25 orange crystals, 300 Phoenix Stones, 250 Dragon Holy Stones, 250 Illusory Color Stones, 200 Mystic Phoenix Stones, or 200 Seven-color Stones).[/p][p]The Wei Kingdom Divine General Box and Wu Kingdom Divine General Box have been replaced with 2 "Divine General Selection Boxes", and the "Sure Success Enhancement Pills" have been replaced with "Divine Enhancement Box" (choose one of 2 Sure Success Enhancement Pills or 400 Ascension Pills). The divine general fragments in the rewards have been changed to "Divine Yu Ji Fragment".[/p][p]Activity 11: New Super Discount Event Starts[/p][p]The discounted items for this period are: Divine Guan Yu Fragment, 100 Noble Points, Medium Building Accelerator, Infantry 3-star Material Pack, 1,000 Noble Points, Medium Stamina Potion, Medium Recruitment Order, and Merit.[/p][p]Activity 12: Update of Divine General Fragments in Merit Mall, Honor Mall, and Tiger Emblem Mall[/p][p]Honor Mall updated to: Divine Lu Bu Fragment, Divine Zhao Yun Fragment;[/p][p]Merit Mall updated to: Divine Diao Chan Fragment, Divine Liu Bei Fragment;[/p][p]Tiger Emblem Mall updated to: Divine Dong Zhuo Fragment, Divine Cao Ren Fragment;[/p][p]The new version is under development and will be updated gradually. notes.title: Maintenance Notice on August 28th
notes.notes: [p]The server will be under maintenance from 10:00 to 12:00 on Thursday, August 28, 2025. During this period, players will not be able to log in. Please inform each other, dear lords.[/p][p]The new server S420 will be open on Saturday, August 23, at 10:00 a.m.[/p][p]The old player return event will start on August 28, 2025.[/p][p]Old player return event details:[/p][p]Event period: 0:00 on August 28, 2025 - 23:59 on September 3, 2025.[/p][p]Returning player definition: Players who have not logged in for 7 consecutive days since the start of the event and log in for the first time during the event period will be identified as returning players. Their status will not be changed after that.[/p][p]Returning players can bind one non-returning player in the same server.[/p][p]Non-returning player definition: Players who do not meet the returning player definition will be identified as non-returning players when they log in for the first time during the event period. Their status will not be changed during the event. New characters created during the event are also considered non-returning players.[/p][p]Non-returning players can be bound by up to three returning players in the same server.[/p][p]During the event: Returning players will receive corresponding resource and gold rewards based on their inactivity period upon their first login.[/p][p]All players can claim daily login rewards every day during the event.[/p][p]Returning and non-returning players can claim corresponding rewards after reaching the specified recharge amount during the event.[/p][p]Additional rewards distribution:[/p][p]When claiming the single-day and consecutive recharge benefits in the return event, the bound player will also receive the corresponding rewards via email at the same time.[/p][p]To claim multiple rewards, quickly find your former comrades and get them to return and fight together![/p][p]Remember to have them bind to you after logging in![/p][p]The new version content is under production and will be updated gradually. Stay tuned.[/p]

notes.title: Maintenance Notice for June 5th
notes.notes:
On Thursday, June 5, 2025, from 10:00 to 12:00, the entire server will undergo maintenance. During the maintenance, you will not be able to log in to the game. Please inform each other, dear lords.
The new server S408 will be open at 10 a.m. on Saturday, May 31st.
The return event for old players kicks off on June 5th.
The return event for veteran players has begun:
The event period is from 0:00 on June 5, 2025 to 23:59 on June 11, 2025.
Returning player definition: Starting from the first login at the beginning of the event, players who have not logged in for 7 consecutive days will be determined as returning players after their first login within the event period, and their status will not be modified thereafter.
Returning players can bind a non-returning player in the same server.
Definition of non-returning players: Players who do not meet the definition of returning players will be determined as non-returning players when they log in for the first time during the event period. Non-returning players can be bound by three returning players from the same server.
During the event: Returning players will receive corresponding resource and gold coin rewards upon their first login based on the time they lost.
During the event, all players can claim the daily login reward every day.
During the event, both returning players and non-returning players can claim the corresponding rewards after reaching the corresponding recharge amount.
Distribution of additional rewards:
When claiming the single-day and consecutive recharge benefits in the return event, the bound players will also receive the corresponding rewards via email at the same time.
If you want to claim multiple rewards, hurry up and find your former comrades-in-arms and bring them back to fight together.
Remember to make them bind you after logging into the game!
The content of the new version is under development and will be updated gradually. Stay tuned.

Added 1: Battle Challenge Gameplay
You can switch to the battle scene through the main interface menu button "Battle" button to challenge. There is no limit on the number of challenges, and players with strength can challenge until the final level.
Battle rewards: You can get level rewards and battle mission rewards for each challenge victory. The battle gameplay can only be challenged once per season, the new season will be reset, and the enemy will become stronger according to the season. There are rich rewards for the battle, including the props of the new system, such as skin props, general equipment, stargazing system, props consumed by the soaring system, etc.
New 2: General Skin System
Generals can obtain different skin appearances, and can use skin props to activate to obtain generals's skin. After the general's skin is activated, you need to go to the general details page corresponding to the general's interface to wear it. After using the skin, the card image and body image of the general will change.
Activation attributes: Activate the skin to get the skin attributes (no need to use, as long as you activate, you can increase the attributes corresponding to the general of the same name).
Collect attributes: Activating a certain number of skins will also increase the speed attributes for all generals.
Star ascension attribute: After the general's skin is activated, you can upgrade it, and the star will continue to increase the attribute value.
Prop acquisition: Skin activation props and upgrade props can be obtained for free in the battle system. Of course, it can also be obtained in cumulative rewards and a large number of paid gift packages.
New 3: Equipment System
The generals have added equipment functions, and the general equipment paging is added to the general interface. After players get the equipment, they can equip the generals and add various attributes.
Ways to obtain equipment: challenge level rewards, equipment extraction in the production workshop in the main city, shopping mall purchase, and various paid activities.
New 4: Gemstone System
Gemstones can be used for equipment inlaying. After inlaying the equipment, the equipment can obtain gem attributes. After being worn by generals, the corresponding attributes can be added. The Iron Temple adds the function of gem synthesis, which can synthesize low-level gems of the same type into higher-level gems of the same type.
Ways to get gems: challenge level rewards, mall purchases.
Added 5: Stargazing, Ascension, Military Book System
The general has added its own strengthening function, and the consumption of the corresponding props can greatly improve all kinds of generals. You can go to the details page of the corresponding generals for operation.
Ways to obtain all kinds of enhanced props: battle challenge level rewards, production workshop extraction and acquisition, mall purchase.

On Monday, February 20, S253-S279 and S283-S285 will clean up inactive accounts from time to time, and each cleaning will last 10-20 minutes. Inactive accounts refer to: 1. It does not occupy land above level 10. 2. It has not been online for three consecutive days. 3. No recharge has been made. At the same time, if the above three points are met, the inactive account will be cleaned up.
The full server will be maintained from 10:00 to 14:00 on Thursday, February 23. After maintenance, S253-S279 will enter the fourth season, and S283-S285 will enter the second season. For details of the season, please refer to the season description in the general trend of the world. The progress and number of recruitments of wish card bags and Nirvana card bags in the new season will be reset. Please pay more attention to it.
"The Lord of the Three Kingdoms" is now on the TikTok account. Please pay attention to the TikTok account: 54744242629
In order to collect materials for short videos on our TikTok account, we now release short video collection activities.
Welcome all the protagonists to contribute to the wonderful video of the game "The Lord of the Three Kingdoms", including but not limited to the wonderful hot-blooded scenes such as national war, city war, battle, fun, etc. Once the submitted video is released to our TikTok account, the contributor of the video will be rewarded by an optional general box.
Special note: The submitted video will default to the official right to use, and the video will be used for publicity and promotion. Contributors should note the area server and name so that the reward can be issued after adopting the video.
The video manuscript can be sent to customer service Xiaotian in the official Q group 736650260 during working hours, and the customer service will make a record.
The new service S288 will open at 10 a.m. on Saturday, February 25.
On February 23, the return of old players began.
The return activity of old players begins:
Activity time: 00:00 on February 23 - 23:59 p.m. on March 1.
Return player definition: calculated from the first login at the beginning of the activity, players who have not logged in for 7 consecutive days will be judged to return players after logging in for the first time during the activity, and their status will not be modified.
Returning players can bind a non-returning player with the same server.
Non-return player definition: Players who do not meet the definition of return players will be judged as non-return players when logging in for the first time during the activity time. The intermediate state will not be modified. New characters created during the event are also non-returning players.
Non-returning players can be bound to return players of 3 servers.
During the activity: Returning players will issue corresponding resources and ingot rewards according to the lost time when logging in for the first time.
All players can receive daily login rewards during the activity.
Returning players and non-returning players can receive corresponding rewards after recharging the corresponding amount during the activity.
Distribution of additional rewards:
When receiving one-time and continuous recharge benefits in the return event, the players bound to it will also receive the corresponding rewards by email.
If you want to get multiple rewards, go to your former comrades-in-arms and let them return to fight together.
Remember to let them log in to the game and bind you!

notes.title: Three Kingdoms coming！
notes.notes:
Are you still playing the old Three Kingdoms mobile game? Are you tired of the same strategy of the Three Kingdoms?
The largest Three Kingdoms strategy mobile game in history is coming!
"The Lord of the Three Kingdoms" will be released on January 14th! Download and play!
This is a unique Three Kingdoms mobile game, with the most passionate war strategy and the most colorful gameplay, which will definitely refresh you and brighten your eyes. The new Q version of the Three Kingdoms is the largest in history. Thousands of people fight against the country on the same screen. This fierce battle for hegemony of the Three Kingdoms is waiting for you to explore and conquer.
As a Three Kingdoms offensive and defensive strategy mobile game, we have always been committed to creating a real Three Kingdoms battlefield for players, so that players can experience real battlefield confrontation. And launched a new special "national war" gameplay, creating a vast national war territory for players, with nearly 100 cities waiting for players to capture! Players on the whole network have the same map, the same battlefield, princes from all walks of life command thousands of troops and horses, chase the deer world, attack, defend and conquer the era of the national war!

Launch the "national war" gameplay and upgrade the "strategic" gameplay in an all-round way. Players' play with the Three Kingdoms is no longer limited to fighting wisdom and courage in platoon deployment and urban defense construction. Strategic and tactics are the key to a decisive victory.

In the era of the National War, the group P is even higher!!!

A brainstorming, a collision of wisdom! It is not known who will die!

Seeing this, can't you wait to download our new game package??
See you on January 14th!
